chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about running water in which urine is passed. He said: There is no harm.

key_terms.الْمَاءِ الْجَارِي: running water, meaning flowing water in the legal context
key_terms.سَأَلْتُهُ: I asked him; introducing the question posed to the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; indicating permissibility or absence of objection
key_terms.يُبَالُ: urine is passed; referring to the act of urinating

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urinating in running water according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding urinating in running water, stating that there is no harm in it. In context, it pertains to fiqh discussions on taharah and the rulings of water, especially the distinction between flowing and stagnant water.
